description: Ministry of City Planing & Water Supply - Order made to approve the acquisition of Servitude rights of the Navariyanwatta, D/S/D, Galle, Four Gravets, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette primarily deals with land acquisition for servitude rights, specifically describing the acquisition of a land parcel for constructing an access road to a wastewater treatment plant. It includes detailed land description, boundaries, location details (Grama Niladhari Division, Divisional Secretary's Division, District), and the extent of the land (05 perches). While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) and references a legal act, the core content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette.
